messages:
sam: Heads-up: new draft of the product launch blog is posted in the drive (link in doc). Need a short copy pass + alignment on CTAs and lead routing today. Quick asks: 1) headline one-liner, 2) benchmark claim + footnote wording, 3) CTA variants for hero and footer, 4) HubSpot routing for NA vs EMEA. Can you skim? :coffee:

viv: Pinged. I'll do a pass on headline and CTAs. For hero copy, proposing two options: A) 'Serve LLMs at predictable latency and lower unit cost' B) 'Production-ready LLM inference that scales with your business.' Thoughts?

mike: Benchmarks: clarify environment. Are these internal Dedicated runs on A100nv? If so we need to say 'internal performance benchmarks on Dedicated alpha (A100nv, Mar 2026)'. Legal usually wants measurement window and config. Avoid 'guaranteed' language.

sam: Yep that's accurate. I'll update the footnote. Draft bench line currently: 'Up to 4x lower token cost in our tests vs baseline fp16.' Open to editing to be safer.

diane: Legal quick review: prefer 'up to 4x in internal performance benchmarks (see methodology)'. Add exact test dates and a short description of baseline. Also remove comparative wording that could be read as SLA.

viv: For CTAs, proposing hero CTA = 'Book a technical demo' and secondary = 'View benchmark details'. Footer CTA could be 'Request trial access'. Recommend we A/B test hero CTA with 70% demo / 30% benchmark.

mike: Routing notes: demo -> SDR queue by region, benchmark -> marketing nurture track, trial -> product ops. For EMEA hours we'll route to EMEA SDR 08:00-18:00 CET; outside that window fall back to NA SDR (ET business hours). Add timezone mapping table in the doc.

publish-bot: Reminder: embargo active until 2026-04-08 17:00 UTC. Please set metadata flag `embargo: true` and remove public links until release window.

sam: Updated doc: swapped headline to option B, adjusted bench phrasing per legal, added methodology link and test metadata. Pasted demo-routing CSV below for ops team:
```
region,segment,demo_type,preferred_window
NA,SMB,Live demo,Mornings ET
NA,Enterprise,Tech deep-dive,Afternoons ET
EMEA,SMB,Recorded + booking,CEST mornings
EMEA,Enterprise,Live deep-dive,CEST afternoons
APAC,Any,Recorded + scheduling,SGT weekdays
```

viv: Design ask: hero image needs to show 'inference at scale' — can we brief with two options: a product diagram and a hero illustration showing multi-region routing? I'll add the brief in Figma request.

diane: Legal approves the updated footnote. One tweak: change the phrase 'our tests' to 'internal performance benchmarks' everywhere.

mike: Ops confirmed HubSpot mapping. I'll drop the nurture tags, lead score rules, and SDR queue IDs into the doc by 3pm. Also proposing CTA A/B variants: 'Book a technical demo' vs 'See the benchmark' split 70/30.

sam: Thanks all. Plan: lock copy with revised headline and bench footnote, finalize CTA split, handoff to ops + design, then final review before embargo lift. Will mark doc ready-for-design and tag stakeholders. :white_check_mark:
